dedupe_keys.name: data for digitally augmented database of fracture critical steel beam to column connection tests

description: Data for: Digitally Augmented Database of Fracture-Critical Steel Beam-to-Column Connection Tests is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Francisco Galvis, Stanford University (stanford.edu). We introduce a compiled database of 100 full-scale steel beam-to-column connections that failed due to flange fracture. This database focuses on welded flange connections tested in the past 50 years, including tests with strong panel zones and box columns that have been excluded from previous collections. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project. Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-5m36-e815. Keywords: Earthquake, steel welded connections, fracture, cyclic tests. Published 2024-01-15. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
